lean.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef),
    ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) A⁻¹ =
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).withDensity (fun x =>
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt A.det / (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)))
approved_definition_context: EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) is real n-dimensional Euclidean space with its canonical inner product and volume; WithLp.ofLp gives coordinates, and squared Euclidean norm is the sum of coordinate squares. The default coordinate Pi sup norm is not substituted.

For covariance C, multivariateGaussian zero C is the existing measure (stdGaussian E).map (fun z => Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt C) z), where stdGaussian is the canonical centered unit-covariance standard Gaussian on this Euclidean space. CFC.sqrt is the actual positive-semidefinite matrix square root on nonnegative self-adjoint matrices.

A.PosDef means real Hermitian symmetry and strictly positive quadratic form on every nonzero coordinate vector; inverse is the existing nonsingular matrix inverse. No asserted density or normalization is built into this predicate.

volume.withDensity f is the measure whose integrals use the displayed nonnegative extended-real density f; ENNReal.ofReal is the nonnegative extended-real embedding of a real value. Equality means equality of measures. All real powers use real division n/2 and Real.sqrt is nonnegative.
